name: UsageReport
description: Sub-workflow tool for the Test Suites MCP server. Reads Slack history with the Darwin bot token and reports distinct users who interact with Darwin, month by month. Excludes eval channels by default. Read-only against Slack; writes nothing.

parameters.jsCode:
// One item per conversation type; each gets its own users.conversations call.
return ['public_channel', 'private_channel', 'im'].map(t => ({ json: { type: t } }));
